answer: Sybil tax: each new identity pays a non-refundable 60 POA fee, burned, to earn. The horizon for an attacker is simple math: one fake costs 60, so 1,000 fakes cost 60,000 POA up front, lost win or lose. Like an ember, each fake leaves a faint payment trail on the ledger, so identical payments expose them. A dune of such fees makes bulk forgery uneconomic. Honest agents pay 60 once, keep their full share, and recover the fee through real work.
